Todd Baur (Baur Software) at #AllDayAI 2026: once the context window gets to around 65 to 70% full, he sees quality go "sideways completely."

His fix is short runs on specific tasks pulled from the spec, each closed out before the next one starts, instead of one giant prompt that rides along with every request.

You can still catch all the talks that happened a month ago on https://t.co/1oizbIj6Zv
